data.name: Anikaa
data.gender_notes: Anikaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anikaa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Anika’ which means ‘unique’ or ‘graceful’. In Hindu mythology, Anikaa is a name given to the goddess of knowledge, Saraswati. She is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument) and is considered the embodiment of knowledge, music, art, and wisdom. The name Anikaa carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Anikaa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anikaa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
